name: PLC → InfluxDB line protocol
func:
// =============================================
// 模擬完整 PLC DB74 資料 → InfluxDB line protocol
// 涵蓋所有 is_active=1 plc_points（62點）
// 到現場時：刪除「模擬資料」區塊，改用真實 msg.payload
// =============================================

// --- 模擬資料（到現場刪掉這段）---
var r = Math.random;

// 主機組運行狀態（讓相關數值有邏輯關聯）
var power = 800 + r() * 600;          // 800–1400 kW
var flow = power / 600 + r() * 0.2;  // ~1.5–2.5 cms
var guideVane = 40 + r() * 40;           // 40–80 %
var speedRpm = 350 + r() * 20;          // 350–370 rpm

// 閥門狀態（主管路正常全開）
var mainOpen = 1;
var dn1350Open = r() > 0.3 ? 1 : 0;     // DN1350 偶爾關閉
var opvOpen = r() > 0.9 ? 1 : 0;      // 洩壓閥幾乎不開

var simulated = {
    // ── 水輪機 ──────────────────────────────────
    TURB_FLOW_IN: rnd(flow, 2),
    TURB_FLOW_OUT: rnd(flow - 0.05 + r() * 0.1, 2),
    TURB_PRESS_BEFORE: rnd(5.5 + r() * 1.5, 2),
    TURB_PRESS_AFTER: rnd(4.0 + r() * 1.5, 2),
    TURB_GUIDE_VANE: rnd(guideVane, 1),
    CALC_FLOW_PLUNGER: rnd(dn1350Open * (flow * 0.3 + r() * 0.1), 2),
    CALC_FLOW_TOTAL: rnd(flow + dn1350Open * 0.3, 2),

    // ── 發電機 ──────────────────────────────────
    GEN_SPEED: rnd(speedRpm, 1),
    GEN_SPEED_PCT: rnd(speedRpm / 360 * 100, 1),
    GEN_POWER_P: rnd(power, 2),
    GEN_POWER_Q: rnd(-100 + r() * 200, 2),
    GEN_POWER_S: rnd(power * 1.05 + r() * 10, 2),
    GEN_TEMP_U: rnd(60 + r() * 25, 1),
    GEN_TEMP_V: rnd(60 + r() * 25, 1),
    GEN_TEMP_W: rnd(60 + r() * 25, 1),
    GEN_TEMP_ENV: rnd(22 + r() * 12, 1),
    GEN_VIB_DE: rnd(0.3 + r() * 0.9, 2),
    GEN_VIB_NDE: rnd(0.3 + r() * 0.9, 2),
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_DE: rnd(45 + r() * 25, 1),
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_NDE: rnd(45 + r() * 25, 1),

    // ── 電氣量 ──────────────────────────────────
    ELEC_VOLT_AB: rnd(388 + r() * 8, 1),
    ELEC_VOLT_BC: rnd(388 + r() * 8, 1),
    ELEC_VOLT_CA: rnd(388 + r() * 8, 1),
    ELEC_CURR_L1: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732, 1),   // ≈ P/(√3·U)
    ELEC_CURR_L2: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732, 1),
    ELEC_CURR_L3: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732, 1),
    ELEC_CURR_L1P: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732 * (0.95 + r() * 0.1), 1),
    ELEC_CURR_L2P: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732 * (0.95 + r() * 0.1), 1),
    ELEC_CURR_L3P: rnd(power / 0.69 / 1.732 * (0.95 + r() * 0.1), 1),

    // ── HPU 液壓站 ──────────────────────────────
    HPU_PRESS_TURB1: rnd(145 + r() * 15, 1),
    HPU_PRESS_BYPASS2: rnd(290 + r() * 30, 1),
    HPU_TEMP_TURB1: rnd(38 + r() * 10, 1),
    HPU_TEMP_BYPASS2: rnd(38 + r() * 10, 1),

    // ── 控制盤 ──────────────────────────────────
    CTRL_TEMP: rnd(24 + r() * 14, 1),

    // ── 環境 ─────────────────────────────────────
    ENV_NOISE_IN: rnd(55 + r() * 20, 1),
    ENV_NOISE_OUT: rnd(60 + r() * 25, 1),
    ENV_WATER_IN: rnd(2 + r() * 3, 2),
    ENV_WATER_OUT: rnd(1 + r() * 3, 2),

    // ── 閥門開度 ─────────────────────────────────
    VALVE_DN1350_PCT: rnd(dn1350Open * (20 + r() * 80), 1),

    // ── 洩壓閥壓力 ──────────────────────────────
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_WATER: rnd(6 + r() * 4, 2),
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_HYD: rnd(80 + r() * 40, 1),

    // ── DN1350 閥前後壓力 ────────────────────────
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_IN: rnd(7 + r() * 3, 2),
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_OUT: rnd(5 + r() * 3, 2),

    // ── 閥門開關回饋（Bool）──────────────────────
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_OPEN: dn1350Open,
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_CLOSE: 1 - dn1350Open,
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_OPEN: mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_CLOSE: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_OPEN: mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_CLOSE: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN900_FB_OPEN: mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN900_FB_CLOSE: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_OPV_FB_OPEN: opvOpen,
    VALVE_OPV_FB_CLOSE: 1 - opvOpen,
    VALVE_OPV_ALARM: 0,
    // 充水閥（主閥開啟時充水閥關閉）
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_OPEN: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_CLOSE: mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_OPEN: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_CLOSE: mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_OPEN: 1 - mainOpen,
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_CLOSE: mainOpen,

    // ── 系統告警（正常運行=0）────────────────────
    SYS_SHUTDOWN_ALARM: 0,
    SYS_UPS_ALARM: 0
};
// --- 模擬資料結束 ---

// 四捨五入輔助
function rnd(val, decimals) {
    var m = Math.pow(10, decimals);
    return Math.round(val * m) / m;
}

var deviceMap = {
    TURB_FLOW_IN: "turbine",
    TURB_FLOW_OUT: "turbine",
    TURB_PRESS_BEFORE: "turbine",
    TURB_PRESS_AFTER: "turbine",
    TURB_GUIDE_VANE: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_PLUNGER: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_TOTAL: "general",
    GEN_SPEED: "generator",
    GEN_SPEED_PCT: "generator",
    GEN_POWER_P: "generator",
    GEN_POWER_Q: "generator",
    GEN_POWER_S: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_U: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_V: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_W: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_ENV: "generator",
    GEN_VIB_DE: "generator",
    GEN_VIB_NDE: "generator",
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_DE: "generator",
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_NDE: "generator",
    ELEC_VOLT_AB: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_BC: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_CA: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L1: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L2: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L3: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L1P: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L2P: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L3P: "electrical",
    HPU_PRESS_TURB1: "hpu",
    HPU_PRESS_BYPASS2: "hpu",
    HPU_TEMP_TURB1: "hpu",
    HPU_TEMP_BYPASS2: "hpu",
    CTRL_TEMP: "control",
    ENV_NOISE_IN: "environment",
    ENV_NOISE_OUT: "environment",
    ENV_WATER_IN: "environment",
    ENV_WATER_OUT: "environment",
    VALVE_DN1350_PCT: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_WATER: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_HYD: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_IN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_OUT: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_ALARM: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    SYS_SHUTDOWN_ALARM: "control",
    SYS_UPS_ALARM: "control"
};

var lines = [];
for (var tag in simulated) {
    var device = deviceMap[tag] || "unknown";
    var val = simulated[tag];
    lines.push("measurements,plant_id=hushan,tag_code=" + tag + ",device_code=" + device + " value=" + val);
}

msg.payload = lines.join("\n");
msg.headers = {
    "Authorization": "Token UrXPX5bskMb-AwIKOm7k7AuLPVuxiSaIUd943uhHwrZcg2gbI4K7fsfWWMqyxTqJi5iFpGNstKQvHwmdkxxGfQ==",
    "Content-Type": "text/plain"
};
msg.url = "http://192.168.14.203:8086/api/v2/write?org=SCADA_hushan&bucket=demo_realtime&precision=ms";
return msg;
